packages.title: Platinum
packages.description: Our highest tier of partnership. Platinum sponsors receive premium placement across all Wings to Fly productions and events, including back cover advertising, full-screen digital recognition, VIP tickets to every event, logo placement across all platforms, and exclusive private workshop experiences for up to 10 guests.

benefits.name: Annual Theatrical Show program ad
benefits.detail: Full back cover + presenting sponsor logo on front cover

benefits.name: Logo on our website sponsor page

packages.title: Gold
packages.description: A premier sponsorship with broad visibility across our full season. Gold sponsors are recognized in print, digitally, and on social media, and receive VIP access to all major events plus a private workshop experience.

benefits.name: Logo on our website sponsor page

packages.title: Silver
packages.description: Meaningful visibility throughout our season with print and digital recognition, logo placement on our website and social media, VIP tickets to all major productions, and a private sound and relaxation workshop for up to 3 guests.

benefits.name: Logo on our website sponsor page

packages.title: Bronze
packages.description: A strong community presence with full-page print advertising at our Gala, full-screen digital recognition at our Winter Show, website and social media logo placement, and tickets to all major events.

benefits.name: Logo on our website sponsor page

packages.title: Patron
packages.description: Community-level support with half-page print recognition at our Gala, full-screen digital presence at our Winter Show, social media logo placement, and tickets to our signature productions.

benefits.name: Logo on our website sponsor page

packages.title: Partner
packages.description: An accessible entry point into our sponsor family. Partners receive quarter-page print recognition, shared digital screen time at our Winter Show, social media visibility, and tickets to our Theatrical Show and Winter Show.

packages.title: Legacy Circle
packages.description: You are part of something bigger than a season. Legacy Circle members make a profound ongoing commitment to Wings to Fly — helping shape the future of inclusive arts in our community and ensuring our mission endures for generations to come.

packages.title: Visionary Donor
packages.description: You are leading the way in making inclusion possible. Visionary Donors provide meaningful monthly support that sustains our scholarship program and empowers more community members to experience the joy and healing of movement.

packages.title: Dream Builder
packages.description: You are helping build something lasting. Dream Builders provide consistent, reliable support that allows Wings to Fly to plan ahead, invest in our participants, and bring new programming ideas to life month after month.

packages.title: Scholarship Champion
packages.description: Your generosity directly opens doors. As a Scholarship Champion, your monthly gift helps fund participation for individuals who might not otherwise have access to the transformative power of inclusive dance and movement.

packages.title: Friend of Wings
packages.description: Every gift matters. As a Friend of Wings, your monthly contribution helps keep our doors open and our programs thriving — ensuring that dance, movement, and inclusion remain accessible to our community throughout the year.

packages.title: Angel
packages.description: For those who give from the heart. Angel sponsors are honored by name in our printed programs and recognized across all events on a monthly basis. Specific benefits are determined in conversation with Wings to Fly leadership.
